The boat has a sturdy hull, visible railings, and is positioned in front of a large orange industrial crane or bridge structure against a blue sky and sea background. artifact_observations.location: Water cannon nozzles and piping on the bow
artifact_observations.reasoning: The water cannons lack clear mechanical definition. The nozzles appear to melt into the deck housing, and the piping geometry is nonsensical, lacking distinct joints, valves, or rotational bases expected in real engineering.

The truss work of the background structure exhibits inconsistent perspective lines. Some beams appear to pass through others without proper occlusion, and the lattice pattern warps unnaturally towards the right edge.

The paint texture is overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking the subtle imperfections, rivets, or panel lines typical of a steel vessel. Reflections on the windows are generic and do not match the environment accurately.
Vertical stanchions of the railings blend slightly into the deck surface rather than sitting distinctly on top. Small deck fixtures appear fused together rather than being separate bolted components.
